_comment: Provenance for every guideline PDF. Dates are copied from the documents themselves (cover page 'Published:'). 'accessed_date' is filled in by scripts/download_guidelines.py. Add an entry here for every PDF you place in pdfs/.

documents.title: Cough (acute): antimicrobial prescribing (NICE guideline NG120)
documents.publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE), UK

population.description: Adults, young people and children with acute cough (upper respiratory tract infection or acute bronchitis). Individual recommendations carry their own age limits in the text.
